experience.title: Front End Developer
bullets: Delivered front end solutions for internal CMS platform and consumer-facing client app in monetization/adTech space, resolving 120+ Jira tasks while translating Figma designs into pixel-perfect, responsive UI
Migrated consumer-facing client app from Vuetify to Tailwind across 40+ Vue components for improved user experience, reducing bundle size by 19%

Conducted performance audits and optimizations on the client app, improving Largest Contentful Paint (LCP) from 9.1s to 6.6s, driving a 15% conversion rate improvement based on UI/UX and Web Vitals enhancements
experience.skills: Vue, Nuxt, TypeScript, JavaScript, Tailwind, Vuetify, Figma, CI/CD

experience.title: Lead Developer
bullets: Architected and developed from scratch an end-to-end CRM with WooCommerce integration serving sales operations, implementing RESTful APIs in Laravel for seamless data exchange with WooCommerce and Panama's electronic bill API for automated invoicing and tax compliance, achieving near 100% delivery success rate

Implemented CI/CD pipelines and AWS S3 secure storage, reducing deployment time from 20min to 4min, and mentored 3 developers on Laravel and Vue best practices improving code review approval rate from 40% to 85%
experience.skills: Laravel, PHP, JavaScript, Vue, Vuetify, PostgreSQL, AWS S3, Wordpress, WooCommerce, CI/CD

experience.title: Full Stack Developer
bullets: Contributed multi-tenant SaaS features across modules for Fire Prevention, EMS and Assets operations serving 40+ fire departments across United States and Canada, helping drive company success as it made Inc 5000 list for four consecutive years since 2022

Enhanced Google Maps and ArcGIS APIs integrations for geolocation mapping with real-time tracking, and implemented custom barcode/QR scanner component processing 5,000+ daily asset scans with >99% accuracy
experience.skills: Vue, Yii, Google Maps API, ArcGIS API, PostgreSQL, PHP, JavaScript
